channel.title: Merthyra Changelog
channel.description: Website releases and redesign updates from Merthyra.

item.title: Website Redesign
item.description: Merthyra.com was redesigned with a new app hub, dedicated Merthyra and Merthyra Control landing pages, clearer navigation, responsive layouts, and a colorful liquid glass style.

item.title: Website Release
item.description: The original Merthyra website launched with its first product landing page, documentation, changelog, policies, beta terms, and community access.
